_: The arms painted foes already have (P50), each one limb of the drawing: shoulder, elbow, hand, in game px of the foe's box (facing right, feet at the bottom). tools/mob-svg.cjs draws the whole painting from these as it always did, draws the body without them (<kind>-body), and cuts each arm into an upper arm (shoulder to elbow: frame <kind>-arm-<id>-upper, box `up`, pivot the shoulder) and a forearm with whatever is in the hand (<kind>-arm-<id>-lower, box `low`, pivot the elbow); a box is [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the same px. src/arms.ts rigs them. far: drawn behind the body; phase: 0 or 1, the walk's counter-swing (an arm swings against the leg on its side).
